handoff.salientSummary: Implemented F1.1 minikube backend: extended cluster-up.sh/cluster-down.sh with minikube provider support, added shared prefix-check.sh library enforcing ^chart-test-swarm-[a-z0-9-]+$ across all cluster-touching scripts, added minikube to scenario schema enum, fixed default CLUSTER_NAME values, and added kubeconfig context restoration + KEEP_CLUSTER=1 default + SIGINT cleanup. 25 bats tests all green, shellcheck clean (style-only), schema validation passes all 5 pre-existing scenarios.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
1) engine/scripts/lib/prefix-check.sh — shared library sourced by cluster-up.sh, cluster-down.sh, run-scenario.sh, and dispatch-swarm.sh that validates CLUSTER_NAME matches ^chart-test-swarm-[a-z0-9-]+$ before any cluster operation, exiting 1 with descriptive stderr on violation (including rejection of bare prefix with no suffix).
2) engine/scripts/cluster-up.sh — added minikube provider branch (minikube start -p $CLUSTER_NAME --wait=all --wait-timeout=180s), saved and restored kubeconfig context on EXIT trap (VAL-ENGINE-038), sourced prefix-check.sh, changed default CLUSTER_NAME from 'chart-test-swarm' (invalid) to 'chart-test-swarm-default' (valid).
3) engine/scripts/cluster-down.sh — added minikube provider branch (minikube delete -p), idempotent for both kind and minikube (re-running exits 0), sourced prefix-check.sh, fixed default CLUSTER_NAME.
4) engine/scripts/run-scenario.sh — sourced prefix-check.sh, fixed default CLUSTER_NAME, added KEEP_CLUSTER=1 as default (keep) with =0 teardown path (VAL-ENGINE-040), added SIGINT/SIGTERM trap that writes INTERRUPTED status and tears down cluster (VAL-ENGINE-027), fail() now tears down on KEEP_CLUSTER=0 (VAL-ENGINE-026 partial artifacts).
5) engine/scripts/dispatch-swarm.sh — sourced prefix-check.sh, added CLUSTER_NAME default and export, added chart-test-swarm- reference.
6) engine/templates/scenario.schema.json — added 'minikube' to cluster.provider enum.
7) examples/sample-product-chart/chart-test/scenarios/ — fixed customer-A-istio and customer-B-gatekeeper IDs to lowercase (matching schema pattern).
8) engine/scripts/tests/cluster-lifecycle.bats (14 tests), prefix-invariant.bats (5 tests), schema.bats (3 tests) — covering prefix enforcement, minikube support, idempotent teardown, default value regex, KEEP_CLUSTER, unknown provider rejection, schema validation.

commandsRun.observation: 25 tests, 25 passing; covers prefix enforcement (kind+minikube), bare prefix rejection, default CLUSTER_NAME regex, KEEP_CLUSTER=1 default, unknown provider rejection, dispatch prefix sourcing, schema minikube acceptance/rejection, pre-existing scenario validation.
